note: Where a line appears. {TEXT}, {REF} and {ROWS} are filled in by tools/world_run.py. kind 'cta' scenes are for the closing slide. case 'upper' sets the words in capitals; rows wraps them for boards; maxWords keeps a line short enough to draw cleanly. Boards must say how many rows they have, or the model adds a header and a row of nonsense letters, and every scene forbids other words, because any extra text fails the word check. Never add a phone, app, website or screen: Scripture on a screen must look like Chasten, which a drawn scene cannot promise. Keep every scene our own: nothing here copies another account's slides. opener marks scenes striking enough for the first slide.
